exclusion_reason: The recompiled module's linear memory is bounded and does not grow with execution length, and the guest-host crossing cost is measured as the WebAssembly import call, but the 2-GB peak ceiling is a whole-game figure with no game runtime to reach it and the crossing bound is a reference-desktop figure, so the end-to-end ceiling is not certified.
promotion_trigger: Promote to passing when peak memory and growth hold the 2-GB ceiling under a real game workload and crossing cost holds the bound on the pinned reference desktop.
expected_failing_assertion: No whole-game workload exercises the ceiling and the crossing bound is a reference-desktop figure, so the peak-memory and crossing benchmark cannot be certified here.
active_gate_evidence: test/performance.test.mjs (benchmarkMemory) asserts the recompiled module's linear memory does not grow between a short and a long run (is_growth_bounded), that peak memory is under the 2-GB ceiling, that the guest-host crossing cost is a positive measured value, and that the whole-game ceiling stays red (is_bar_cleared false).
procedure: Run the frozen workload and measure peak and growth.
Measure the per-crossing cost across the boundary.
Compare both against their declared bound.
pass_criterion: Peak and growth hold the ceiling.
